summary: @NomadWarMachine Patterns in atoms just souls of before riffing and remixing on eclipsing sounds. Foregrounds of misery cast in shadows illuminating backgrounds bleeding luminescence in shattered fates #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@NomadWarMachine
Patterns
in atoms
just souls of
before
riffing and
remixing
on
eclipsing sounds.

Foregrounds
of misery
cast in shadows
illuminating
backgrounds
bleeding luminescence
in
shattered fates
#smallpoems
